name: Quick Capture, Fast Resolution, Confidence Insight, and TestFlight Release
userOutcome: A user can record a prediction from Today in one sheet, explicitly choose confidence and a review horizon, resolve due predictions directly, and see a sample-aware comparison between 80%+ confidence and actual outcomes. The app can be built and archived for TestFlight without exposing journal content or test-only behavior.
entryPoints: Today Ready to Revisit / Resolve Predictions action
Settings export, reminders, demo data, and clear-all
productionDataSource: Local SwiftData Decision and Prediction records; UserDefaults preferences; local UserNotifications reminders. No backend, account, analytics, advertising, or third-party SDK.
errorBehavior: Quick Capture and resolution remain visible after a persistence failure, retain user-entered text, roll back unsaved model changes, expose retry/cancel behavior, and emit no success haptic or notification cancellation until persistence succeeds.
layoutScenarios: iPhone portrait, including iPhone 16 Pro Max
iPad portrait and landscape through adaptive SwiftUI layout
accessibilityRequirements: Quick Capture statement, confidence choices, review horizon, validation, and Save have useful VoiceOver labels and logical order.
Confidence and review choices have at least 44x44 point targets and expose selected state.
Fast resolution verdicts announce the action and that the next due prediction will appear.
Insight copy remains understandable without relying on icon, color, or chart interpretation.
No required control is hidden behind keyboard or clipped at largest Dynamic Type.
prohibitedBehavior: Do not preselect or infer a Quick Capture confidence value.
Do not save blank statements, invalid dates, duplicate decisions, or orphaned predictions.
Do not preselect a prediction verdict or count pending predictions in calibration.
Do not dismiss or show success before persistence succeeds.
Do not expose decision or prediction text in notification content.
Do not allow -uiTestReset to alter a Release build.
Do not bundle preview fixtures or automatically seed demo data in Release.
Do not claim calibration from fewer than three resolved predictions in the selected band.
acceptanceTests: QuickCaptureTests: blank statement, explicit confidence, date boundaries, and one-prediction model construction
ResolutionTests: no preselected verdict, duplicate protection, rollback/retry, quick-capture closeout, and pending-reminder eligibility
StatisticsTests: zero/small sample, overconfidence, underconfidence, well-calibrated, partial outcomes, and 80%+ filtering
HindsightCaptureFlowUITests: Quick Capture primary path, Quick Capture at accessibility XXXL, and retained detailed-wizard path
Release archive validates bundle/version/build/privacy/encryption metadata and code signature
Manual physical-device Quick Capture, Resolve, notification/deep-link, export/delete/relaunch, VoiceOver, and largest Dynamic Type pass
